description: JavaScript code for managing subpanels in SuiteCRM, including dynamic loading, layout management, and user interactions.

classes.name: SUGAR.subpanelUtils
classes.description: Object managing subpanel layout, loading, and user interactions in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: get_module_name
methods.description: Retrieves the current module name from the DetailView form.

methods.name: subp_nav
methods.description: Recreates navigation URL for subpanel actions (detail/edit).

methods.name: sub_p_rem
methods.description: Removes a relationship from a subpanel and refreshes it.

methods.name: sp_rem_conf
methods.description: Confirms removal of a subpanel relationship.

methods.name: sub_p_del
methods.description: Deletes a subpanel record and refreshes the subpanel.

methods.name: sp_del_conf
methods.description: Confirms deletion of a subpanel record.

methods.name: get_record_id
methods.description: Retrieves the current record ID from the DetailView form.

methods.name: get_layout_def_key
methods.description: Retrieves the layout definition key from the DetailView form.

methods.name: save_finished
methods.description: Handles completion of save actions, refreshing the relevant subpanel.

methods.name: set_return_and_save_background
methods.description: Saves data from a popup and updates the subpanel accordingly.

methods.name: got_data
methods.description: Processes AJAX response data to update subpanel HTML content.

methods.name: showSubPanel
methods.description: Displays a subpanel, loading its content via AJAX if necessary.

methods.name: toggleSubpanelCookie
methods.description: Toggles visibility state of a subpanel stored in cookies.

methods.name: markSubPanelLoaded
methods.description: Marks a subpanel as loaded.

methods.name: hideSubPanel
methods.description: Hides a specified subpanel.

methods.name: set_div_cookie
methods.description: Sets a cookie for the display state of subpanels.

methods.name: local_open_popup
methods.description: Opens a popup window.

methods.name: loadSubpanelGroup
methods.description: Loads a group of subpanels, retrieving missing ones via AJAX.

methods.name: updateSubpanels
methods.description: Updates visibility of subpanels based on group configuration.

methods.name: updateSubpanelTabs
methods.description: Updates the tab UI for subpanel groups.

methods.name: updateSubpanelEventHandlers
methods.description: Initializes event handlers for subpanel UI elements.

methods.name: reorderSubpanelSubtabs
methods.description: Reorders subtabs within a subpanel group.

methods.name: updateSubpanelSubtabs
methods.description: Renders the HTML for subpanel subtabs.

methods.name: setGroupCookie
methods.description: Stores the current subpanel group in a cookie.
